entry_shocks.note: from today's $95 to ~$80-85 (-11% to -18%); pre-war Brent ~$70, so some premium stays

EV_US_IRAN_CEASEFIRE_DEAL.reason: No ceasefire or deal is signed as of 4-5 Nov 2026. Doha talks ended without a breakthrough on 2 Nov. Qatar is working toward an 'interim deal'. US strikes on Qeshm Island on 2 Nov. Gulf/European officials say a deal 'will take months' (3 Nov). Hormuz is still disrupted, with tanker hits on 3-5 Nov. Brent fell $117 (30 Oct close) -> $105 (2 Nov) -> $94.6 (4 Nov settle), so much of the deal is already priced. The shock is re-based to today's $95. The group sum was 1.12 before normalisation; it is now 0.85 at 12m, leaving 15% for muddle-through.

entry_shocks.note: $95 -> ~$115 sustained (Oct-30 close was $117); measured from today's $95
Qatar LNG at risk (LNG tanker hit 30 Oct)

EV_IRAN_TALKS_FAIL_ESCALATE.reason: Talks are alive after the US midterms (the Democratic Congress and Vance blaming the war for the loss raise pressure to exit), but strikes continued on 2-3 Nov and Iran calls the US response 'not convincing'. P(sustained >2-week Brent >$110) is lowered. The Brent shock is re-based from $95.

EV_HORMUZ_FULL_CLOSURE.reason: Shock re-based from $95 (the old +60% was framed against ~$95, but the range was too wide on the upside). Hormuz was already at a 'near standstill' on 31 Oct with Brent at only $113-117. The event description's claim that 'flows had normalised by Oct' is wrong. A >$150 outcome needs attacks on Gulf export infrastructure, not just shipping harassment.

entry_shocks.note: Brent 94.99 on 5 Nov = +0.0% since 2026-06-01 (factor_state). The old 4.95 was the y/y LEVEL change, including the Feb-May war run-up
escalation vs 1 Jun (Apr-Jul ceasefire/Islamabad memorandum, collapsed 8 Jul); partly offset by current talks
refining proxy +15.4% since 1 Jun ~ +$1.2/bbl; old +$3/bbl unverified

EV_IRAN_WAR_HORMUZ_OIL.reason: Occurred-event shocks must be CHANGES since the event start or 2026-06-01, not y/y levels. Brent is flat since 1 Jun. With a 4.95 SSU (+49.5%) shock the event moves companies by +36%/-24% (event_impact_rank), above the ±25% plausibility bound. C_RED_SEA is split to avoid double counting with the Houthi event.

entry_shocks.note: residual after +0.8 SSU booked in EV_FED_SEP26_HIKE

EV_UST_SELLOFF_SEP26.reason: Double count. US 10Y occurred-event shocks summed to +3.5 SSU (Fed hike 0.8 + selloff 1.7 + precious-metals 1.5 - 0.3 - 0.2) against +1.68 realised since 1 Jun. DXY summed to +1.83 against +0.73 realised. After this fix and the precious-metals fix: 10Y 0.8+1.2-0.3-0.2 = 1.5 SSU (realised 1.68); DXY 0.73 (realised 0.73).

EV_PRECIOUS_METALS_CRASH_2026.reason: US_10Y (+1.5) and DXY (+0.7) are CAUSES of the gold slump. They are already booked in EV_UST_SELLOFF_SEP26 and EV_FED_SEP26_HIKE, so repeating them here double counts the rate shock for every rate-sensitive company.

EV_FPI_RECORD_OUTFLOW_26.reason: F_RISK_SENTIMENT (+0.4 = +2 VIX pts) is removed. VIX is +0.6 pt since 1 Jun (+3.5%) and India VIX is -7.4% since 1 Jun. The note used a 3-month India VIX change, and the AI-selloff and BoJ events already carry the VIX move. Occurred-event VIX shocks summed to +0.95 SSU against +0.11 realised.

entry_shocks.note: with +0.4 in EV_COKING_COAL_SURGE_AUG26 totals ~+10.5%, matching the event's own ~+10% estimate

EV_STEEL_RALLY_2026.reason: F_COKING_COAL (+1.2) double counts EV_COKING_COAL_SURGE_AUG26 (+1.67). Together they give +43% against a reported ~+22% YTD to $266/t (Kalkine 19 Oct). F_STEEL_INDIA is trimmed so the two events sum to ~+10.5%.

entry_shocks.note: ~+20% since mid-year (YTD +22% to ~$266/t at 19 Oct; volatile in Oct)

EV_COKING_COAL_SURGE_AUG26.reason: Only canonical coking-coal shock (removed from EV_STEEL_RALLY_2026). Trimmed from +25% to ~+20% because the Aug spike partly retraced and the YTD change was +22% on 19 Oct.

entry_shocks.note: change vs start: pump prices frozen, Brent $95 = same as 1 Jun and ~start of Sep; INR -1% since Jun; product cracks +15% since Jun ~ -Rs0.5-1/l

EV_OMC_FUEL_FREEZE_LOSSES.reason: The -3.0 shock is a LEVEL vs a 'normal' Rs3-4/l margin and reflects the Oct peak ($110-117 Brent), not the change to today. At Brent $95 and stable INR, crude cost per litre is back at its 1 Jun/1 Sep level; only higher product cracks hurt. The old value drives -36% for an OMC (>25% bound). Q2 losses are already in reported results and prices.

entry_shocks.note: 100% applies only to patented/branded drugs. Generics and their ingredients are not covered regardless of origin. India is among 20 countries with zero duty on specified specialty drugs. Effective tariff on India's generic-heavy US exports is ~+2pp

EV_US_PHARMA_232_SEP26.reason: Confirmed in force from 29 Sep 2026 (proclamation of 2 Apr 2026; first annex 31 Jul). Generics are exempt and Commerce must report on generics within one year (~Apr 2027), which is the trigger window for EV_PHARMA_GENERICS_TARIFF. The kept +0.5 SSU overstates the effective tariff on Indian exports.

EV_FED_DEC26_HIKE25.reason: Futures price a December hike at ~77-80% after the midterms (TokenPost 4 Nov 76.9%; BigGo 5 Nov ~80%). ADP Oct +86k beat. Warsh says inflation is 'too high'. Shaded slightly below market for the oil collapse and the 6 Nov payrolls risk. 0.58 was below market pricing.

EV_FED_H1_2027_FURTHER_HIKES.reason: Market talk is of 'two more rate hikes' (MarketWatch 4 Nov), i.e. Dec plus one in H1 2027. With P(Dec hike) 0.72, P(>=50bp beyond Oct level by 28 Apr 2027) ~0.40. 3m = Dec+Jan 27 meeting.

EV_FED_H1_2027_CUTS.reason: Cuts need recession or AI bust; Fed is in hiking mode and inflation is at a 3-year high. Lowered from 0.25.

EV_RBI_DEC26_HIKE25.reason: Dates confirmed by RBI: decision 4 Dec 2026, Feb decision 5 Feb 2027. Hawkish voices: SBI chair backs a 50 bp Dec hike (3 Nov), UOB sees consecutive hikes from Dec, HSBC 6% by Dec. Since then Brent fell from $117 to $95, the 10y G-sec rallied 7.44% -> 7.19% (4 Nov) and the rupee is at a 2-week high (~94.35-94.55). Odds: 25 bp 0.42, 50 bp 0.05, hold 0.52, cut 0.01. The 12 Nov Oct CPI print is the swing factor.

entry_shocks.note: base is MFN + 10% Section 301 (IEEPA struck down 20 Feb; Sec 122 lapsed 24 Jul); a deal can cut ~5pp, not 10pp

EV_INDIA_US_INTERIM_DEAL_SIGNED.reason: The interim deal is still stuck (BusinessLine 25 Oct). Reports after the midterms say India's urgency fades (IANS 5 Nov). The White House lists it as 'fulfilled' without a text. The current incremental US tariff on most Indian goods is ~10% (secondary sources), so a -10pp shock would take it to zero.

EV_INDIA_US_TALKS_COLLAPSE.reason: Trump plans more tariffs via executive action after losing Congress (DNA 1 Nov). Section 301 determinations are pending. Slightly raised; group sum 0.73.

EV_OPEC_NOV29_HOLD.reason: The 29 Nov full ministerial is confirmed (2027 quotas/capacity baselines). On 1 Nov the seven core members held Dec targets for a third month. The UAE has LEFT OPEC (Jul 2026) and is ramping toward >5 mb/d; Bousso warns of a price war. That raises the odds of a market-share raise.

EV_OPEC_NOV29_RAISE.reason: Market-share response to the UAE exit and Gulf export recovery. Note: the description wrongly lists the UAE as an OPEC+ member raising quotas.

EV_OPEC_NOV29_CUT.reason: A cut is unlikely with Brent at $95 and members below quota; group sum 0.98.

entry_shocks.note: INCREMENTAL only: final directions issued 27 Apr 2026, already priced (PSU banks -3% on 28 Apr)
reported credit cost; transition add-back spreads it

EV_ECL_ROLLOUT_APR27.reason: ECL is FINAL RBI policy known to the market. RBI issued final asset-classification/provisioning directions on 27 Apr 2026 with an ECL start of 1 Apr 2027, rejected banks' plea for more time, and set the transition. Banks have quantified the hit (SBI Rs19,500 cr post-tax, 3 Nov; Bandhan Rs1,250 cr). Priced view: ~70% of the shock is already in prices, and the start falls outside the 3m window, so 3m p = 0.

EV_ECL_DEFERRED.reason: RBI already rejected a deferral request (Apr 2026). 'Fine-tuning' by the working group (Setty 3 Nov) points to calibration tweaks, not a delayed start. Group sum 0.98.

EV_NEMONSOON26_DEFICIT.reason: Season resolves 31 Dec, which is inside the 3m window, so 3m must equal 12m (was 0.0). TN NEM is +32% above normal at 31 Oct (+51% in 27 days of Oct). Severe cyclone Murasu crossed AP 2-3 Nov and heavy rain is forecast to 8 Nov. A deficient season now needs a very dry Nov-Dec. Old pair summed 1.05.

EV_NEMONSOON26_NORMAL_UP.reason: See deficit event; group sum 0.97. Southern reservoirs were still 43% below average (FACTLY 26 Oct), so keep the conditional shock modest.

EV_STEEL_SAFEGUARD_STEPDOWN_2027.reason: The final duty was notified 30-31 Dec 2025: 12% (21 Apr 2025-20 Apr 2026), 11.5% (21 Apr 2026-20 Apr 2027), 11% (21 Apr 2027-20 Apr 2028). The 2027 step is 11.5% -> 11%, not '12% -> 11.5%' as the description says. It is notified law, so p ~0.95. The steel ministry signalled no change (Reuters 6 Oct). The shock size of -0.05 is fine.

entry_shocks.note: VIX +12.5 pts persistent-equivalent; Aug-2024 intraday +45 pts but closes back <20 within ~2 weeks

EV_YEN_CARRY_UNWIND_RISK.reason: 5 SSU (+25 VIX pts) is the intraday extreme of Aug 2024 and is used as a 12m-horizon shock, which overstates (rank #2 by impact, -35% max). The event also hits both F_US_EQUITIES and F_RISK_SENTIMENT, which reach Indian stocks by parallel paths. USD/JPY is ~157-158 with BoJ hike expectations for Dec (TradingNEWS 2 Nov). Odds trimmed slightly.

entry_shocks.note: VIX to ~29-30 (+12.5 pts), consistent with a -15% S&P drawdown (2022 analogue); +20 pts was inconsistent

EV_AI_CAPEX_RESET_RISK.reason: The VIX shock is inconsistent with the paired S&P shock. Hyperscalers deferred raising guidance but have not cut it (CNBC 29 Oct). Nvidia reports 17 Nov.

EV_FPI_INFLOW_REBOUND.reason: The only calendar quarter that can complete within 3m is Q4 CY26. October had ~-Rs44-48k cr (~-US$5bn) outflow, so Nov-Dec would need ~+US$10bn. Early-Nov buying (Rs20,834 cr in 4 sessions, ~US$2.2bn) helps but is not enough. 12m is unchanged.

EV_RUPEE_BREAK_98_RESERVE_STRESS.reason: The main trigger (Brent >$105) has receded: Brent is $95. The rupee is at a 2-week high of 94.33-94.55 on 5 Nov (Yahoo 94.49 confirmed).

EV_INDIA_RETAIL_FUEL_HIKE.reason: At Brent $95 (flat since 1 Jun), OMC crude cost is back to the June level. UP/Punjab polls are due Feb-Mar 2027. The need for a hike has largely gone.

EV_PRECIOUS_METALS_FURTHER_SLIDE.reason: The F_FED_FUNDS +1.0 shock double counts EV_FED_DEC26_HIKE25 (separate exclusive group, p 0.72). The Fed is a cause here, not an independent shock, and it would add a second rate hit to banks and NBFCs.

EV_PRECIOUS_METALS_REBOUND_H1_2027.reason: The F_US_10Y -1.0 shock duplicates the Fed/Iran-deal events that would cause the rebound (EV_US_IRAN_CEASEFIRE_DEAL, EV_FED_H1_2027_CUTS).

findings.subject: EV_US_IRAN_CEASEFIRE_DEAL / Iran group
findings.issue: There is no signed ceasefire as of 5 Nov 2026, so it should not be marked occurred. Doha talks ended 2 Nov with no breakthrough. Qatar is working toward an 'interim deal' and the US reportedly approved a Qatar-presented draft (Anadolu 3 Nov), but Iran calls it 'not convincing'. US 'defensive' strikes hit Qeshm on 2 Nov, and tanker and seafarer attacks continued 3-5 Nov. Brent: $117 (30 Oct close) -> ~$105 (2 Nov) -> $94.62 (4 Nov settle) -> ~$94 (5 Nov), the steepest weekly loss since 2022. The pre-normalisation group sum was 1.12, which is incoherent. New sum: 0.61 (3m) / 0.85 (12m). Brent shocks are re-based from $95.

findings.subject: EV_IRAN_WAR_HORMUZ_OIL
findings.issue: The occurred shock F_BRENT=4.95 SSU is the y/y LEVEL (+49.5%), not the change since 1 Jun (+0.0%). It produces company moves of +36%/-24%. Override: 0.0. The description also says 'peak ~$110 on 16 Oct', but Brent closed at $117 on 30 Oct.

findings.subject: F_US_10Y / F_DXY (occurred events)
findings.issue: Double count across occurred events. 10Y shocks summed to +3.5 SSU against +1.68 realised since 1 Jun; DXY +1.83 against +0.73. Fixed by trimming EV_UST_SELLOFF_SEP26 to the residual and removing rate/dollar shocks from EV_PRECIOUS_METALS_CRASH_2026.

findings.subject: EV_OMC_FUEL_FREEZE_LOSSES
findings.issue: NEW_OMC_MARKETING_MARGIN -3.0 is a level relative to 'normal' at the Oct peak. It drives -36% for an OMC, above the ±25% bound. With Brent back at $95 (flat since 1 Jun) and INR -1%, the change since the start is about -1 SSU.

findings.subject: F_RISK_SENTIMENT (occurred events)
findings.issue: Occurred VIX shocks sum to +0.95 SSU (+4.75 pts) against +0.56 pt realised since 1 Jun. EV_FPI_RECORD_OUTFLOW_26 used a 3m India-VIX change; India VIX is -7.4% since 1 Jun. Removed.

findings.subject: F_COKING_COAL
findings.issue: Double count: EV_STEEL_RALLY_2026 (+1.2) and EV_COKING_COAL_SURGE_AUG26 (+1.67) give +43% against ~+22% YTD ($266/t, 19 Oct). Kept a single +1.3 in the coking-coal event.

findings.subject: EV_US_MIDTERMS_DEM_SWEEP
findings.issue: Correctly specified as occurred. Democrats won both House and Senate on 3 Nov 2026 (NBC, Global News, RTE, 5 Nov). The small shocks are fine. The F_FPI_FLOWS +0.5 should be read with the Nifty rally on 4-5 Nov, which was mostly oil-driven (already in Brent). It may slightly double count the oil channel via flows; no override.

findings.subject: EV_RBI_OCT26_HIKE25
findings.issue: Verified: repo 5.25% -> 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, stance 'calibrated tightening'. RBI MPC dates: 2-4 Dec 2026 and 3-5 Feb 2027 (official RBI press release, 23 Mar 2026). The April 2027 date is not yet published (FY28 calendar). 10y G-sec fell to 7.19% on 4 Nov from 7.44% on 3 Nov, so EV_RBI_LIQUIDITY_BOND_SELLOFF_OCT26's +1.4 SSU (based on 7.44%) now overstates. Since the event start (~7.38% on 9 Oct) the 10y is about -20 bp. The recent-state clamp should use 7.19%. RBI injected ~Rs2.5 lakh cr (Business Today 4 Nov): liquidity has moved toward deficit.

findings.subject: EV_FED_* groups
findings.issue: Fed funds is 3.75-4.00% (held 28 Oct, 10-2, two dissents for a hike). The Dec 8-9 meeting has an SEP. The 2027 meetings are Jan 26-27, Mar 16-17 and Apr 27-28. Spec bug: FURTHER_HIKES is measured from the Oct level, while PLATEAU/CUTS are measured from the post-Dec level. A Dec hold followed by one hike by April falls in no bucket. Define all three relative to the 3.75-4.00% Oct level.

findings.subject: EV_OPEC_NOV29_RAISE / missing event
findings.issue: The UAE left OPEC in Jul 2026 and is lifting exports toward >5 mb/d in 2027 (Reuters 2 Nov; IEA via EnergyNow 4 Nov). There is no event for it in the catalogue, and the RAISE description wrongly names the UAE as a quota member. Its Brent effect is inside the flat Brent move since June, so no new occurred shock is needed. It does raise the odds of a market-share raise or price war on 29 Nov.

findings.subject: EV_ECL_ROLLOUT_APR27
findings.issue: ECL is FINAL RBI policy already known to the market. Final directions were issued 27 Apr 2026, effective 1 Apr 2027; RBI rejected the banks' plea for delay; PSU banks fell ~3% on the day; banks have quantified the hit (SBI Rs19,500 cr post-tax, 3 Nov). Priced view: treat only ~30% of the shock as unpriced. Deferral is a low-probability tail (0.08).

findings.subject: EV_US_PHARMA_232_SEP26
findings.issue: The tariff is in force from 29 Sep. It is 100% on patented/branded drugs only. Generics and APIs are explicitly NOT covered; India is in the 20-country zero-duty list for specified specialty drugs. The Commerce report on generics is due within a year of the 2 Apr 2026 proclamation (~Apr 2027), which supports EV_PHARMA_GENERICS_TARIFF at 0.12 by 12m. Shock reduced to +0.2 SSU.

findings.subject: US tariff level on India
findings.issue: Secondary sources (not USTR/Federal Register): IEEPA tariffs were struck down 20 Feb 2026. The Section 122 10% surcharge ran 24 Feb-24 Jul 2026. Since 24 Jul most Indian goods pay MFN + 10% Section 301 (China/Vietnam/Thailand 12.5%). New Section 301 determinations are pending. A trade-court ruling (3 Nov) found tariffs illegal but with a narrow block. Deal/collapse shocks are re-sized to this 10% base.

findings.subject: Indian CPI / FPI / USD-INR
findings.issue: Sep CPI is 5.54% (21-month high, food 7.74%), as in the catalogue; Oct CPI is due 12 Nov. UOB sees a tolerance-band breach, so EV_CPI_BREACH_6PCT 0.5/0.6 is reasonable. FPI: Oct equity outflow ~Rs44-48k cr, CY26 >Rs3 trn (~US$32.7bn); early-Nov buying is the strongest in a year. USD/INR is 94.33-94.55 on 5 Nov, matching Yahoo 94.49. An ET headline citing '95.64' appears mis-dated.

findings.subject: EV_POWER_SPOT_SPIKE
findings.issue: F_POWER_PRICE_IN +3.0 (+45%) is based on y/y comparisons (Oct DAM Rs6.66/unit, +149% y/y off a rain-depressed Oct-2025 base), not the change since 1 Jun. The occurred power-price shocks sum to +4.3 SSU (+65%). A change-since-June number has not been verified; low-confidence overstatement.

findings.subject: EV_STEEL_SAFEGUARD_STEPDOWN_2027
findings.issue: The description has the schedule wrong. Year two (11.5%) already started on 21 Apr 2026; the 2027 step is 11.5% -> 11% on 21 Apr 2027. The reported 'Government proposes 12% safeguard duty' headline (ET Infra 30 Oct 2026) was not verified and looks like a recycled 2025 story.

findings.subject: EV_HORMUZ_FULL_CLOSURE
findings.issue: The description says 'flows had normalised by Oct', but Hormuz was at a near standstill on 31 Oct. Iran conditions reopening on its 7-point plan, and India has received 'special access' (TOI 5 Nov). The scenario should be defined as 'Gulf export infrastructure hit / Brent >$130 for >2 weeks'.

findings.subject: Risk-scenario SSU (yen carry, AI capex)
findings.issue: F_RISK_SENTIMENT SSU = +5 VIX pts. Yen carry (+25 pts) and AI reset (+20 pts) used intraday-peak magnitudes as 12m shocks, inconsistent with their paired S&P shocks. Re-sized to +12.5 pts. Both events also shock F_US_EQUITIES and F_RISK_SENTIMENT at once; check that these do not reach Indian stocks through parallel edges, which would double count.

findings.subject: EV_Q2_FY27_GDP_STRONG/SOFT
findings.issue: The release date 2026-11-30 is approximate. Q2 GDP is usually published on the last working day of November (27 Nov 2026 is a Friday). Not verified; no effect beyond the 3m window.
